business_objective: Identify products at risk of discontinuation 24 weeks before range refresh
decision_rationale: Logistic Regression had slightly higher mean chronological CV average precision than Random Forest. Threshold 0.1 achieved the highest F1 among tested thresholds on validation edition 92.
limitations: False positives increase product review workload
Products without a Week -24 snapshot are excluded
Snapshot feature availability must be confirmed for operational use
